title: StreamMessage
description: Control messages on the /ws stream, other than snapshots (see snapshot.schema.json, which carry no type field). Additive changes only within a major spec version.

authMessage.description: Client -> agent, the first message on the socket. Without hosts the client gets the agent's own snapshots only, as before 0.8.0 (FR-49).

hosts.description: Ask a hub for every host's snapshots and the hosts message.

hostsMessage.description: Hub -> client that asked for hosts: all. Sent at once, on every state change and at least every 10 s (FR-49).

os.description: Absent until the host has sent a snapshot that names its OS.

state.description: FR-48. The hub's own host is always live.

lastSeen.description: Time of the last snapshot; absent when none has arrived.

self.description: True for the hub's own host.
